explain.say: Imagine you lift a stone in the garden and find lots of tiny creatures. Which ones are insects? Here is a secret trick: count the legs! Let's sort these minibeasts together.

explain.say: See the Six legs group lighting up? Every insect has six legs, three on each side. Ants, bees, butterflies, ladybirds and grasshoppers all have six. Can you count the legs on the next ant you see?

explain.say: Look at this insect up close. See the middle part glowing? That is the thorax, where all six legs and the wings join on. An insect has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen. Can you point to the head with its feelers?

explain.say: Now the Eight legs group. Spiders have eight legs, only two body parts and no feelers, so a spider is not an insect! Scorpions and ticks have eight legs too. Did you think a spider was an insect before?

faq.q: How many legs does an insect have?
faq.a: Every adult insect has six legs, three on each side of its middle part, the thorax.
asks: Do all insects have six legs?

faq.a: No. A spider has eight legs, two body parts and no antennae. It belongs to a group called arachnids, with scorpions and ticks.
asks: Why is a spider not an insect?

faq.q: What are the three parts of an insect?
faq.a: An insect has a head with eyes, mouth and antennae, a thorax where the legs and wings join, and an abdomen at the back for digesting food and laying eggs.
No. A centipede has one pair of legs on each body section, so it has far more than six. Millipedes have two pairs per section.
asks: How many legs does a centipede have?

faq.a: Antennae are feelers on an insect's head. They smell, taste and touch, helping the insect find food and friends.

facts: All adult insects have six legs and three body parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
In 2021 a millipede named Eumillipes persephone with 1306 legs was described from Western Australia.

quiz.say: You find a minibeast with eight legs. Is it an insect?
quiz.show: A minibeast with eight legs is…
quiz.why: Insects always have six legs, so an eight-legged minibeast, like a spider, is not an insect.

wrong.0: Insects have six legs, not eight.
wrong.2: Baby insects that have legs have six too.

quiz.say: Where do an insect's legs join its body?
quiz.why: All six legs, and the wings, join the thorax, the middle part.

wrong.0: The head has the eyes, mouth and antennae.
wrong.2: The abdomen is the back part, for food and eggs.
